$comment: Project profile for the canon-shipped harness (tools/harness in the sza plugin). Only what differs from the canon defaults is written here. StreamsPlayer numbers its tickets SP-0001 (declared in AGENTS.md); the hand-kept tickets before SP-0255 are registered as spent ids in PLAN/spec-catalog-burned-ids.jsonl and are not in the ledger. The harness queue is PLAN/PQ_QUEUE.md; PLAN/RELEASE_QUEUE.md stays the owner's own table and no tool writes it. Run harness scripts through the plugin, never by copying them.
